description_en: Updates the list of collaborators for a task flow by calling the UpdateTaskFlowCooperators operation
description_zh: 调用UpdateTaskFlowCooperators接口，更新任务流相关人员列表
name: UpdateTaskFlowCooperators

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can view the tenant ID by hovering over the profile icon in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The task flow ID. You can obtain this parameter by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: The list of user IDs of the collaborators to update
parameters.help_zh: 待更新的相关人员用户Id列表
parameters.name: cooperator_ids

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
